title: Interslavic Language | Will Bulgarian, Polish and Croatian understand a CONSTRUCTED LANGUAGE? | #1
summary: A Polish linguist tests whether speakers of Bulgarian, Polish and Croatian can understand Interslavic, a constructed language built from Slavic languages. It shows how well they follow it without prior study.
why: HN points to it as a striking demonstration that Interslavic works for speakers of different Slavic languages.

quote.text: the fact that you understand foreigners with zero training just blows my mind
